{{Quote|I bid you hello. Master Woodle only speaks Mon Calamari. Master Woodle was once a captain on a freighter, but he is now retired.|J1-P0|<ref name="JTL" />}}
'''J1-P0''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who was owned by [[Kulton Woodle]], a retired [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. During that period, the [[Protocol droid/Legends|droid]] spent [[Time/Legends|time]] standing with Woodle outside of the [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|Theed Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
A [[Class three droid/Legends|class three]]<ref name="TNEGTD" /> [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]]<ref name="JTL" /> manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]],<ref name="TNEGTD" /> J1-P0 was active following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="JTL" /> The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid's]]<ref name="TNEGTD" /> owner was [[Kulton Woodle]], a member of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who had retired from being a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]]. Following Woodle's retirement, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] spent [[Time/Legends|time]] standing with its master outside the entrance of the [[Theed Spaceport/Legends|Theed Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. J1-P0 informed everyone who spoke with it that Woodle was a retired freighter captain who only spoke the [[Mon Calamari (language)/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="JTL" />

==Characteristics==
Standing 1.7 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall,<ref name="TNEGTD" /> J1-P0 was equipped with [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and silver-colored plating.<ref name="JTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
J1-P0 was a non-player character who was featured in [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']], a [[2004]] expansion pack produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment for<ref name="JTL" /> the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> which was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the droid was present with its master, Kulton Woodle, outside of the Theed spaceport on Naboo, with J1-P0 only stating a single line and Woodle never mentioning the droid when speaking with player characters. Due to the limited interaction with the droid and because almost all characters in ''Star Wars Galaxies''&mdash;including J1-P0&mdash;had text-only dialogue, the droid's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] was not revealed in the game.<ref name="JTL" />
